verdict.comment: The way she's going, CLOUDBUSTER may be able to improve past top-rated Chairmanfourtimes who commands respect all the same.

comments.chairmanfourtimes: Consistent efforts thus far; solid contender and is top on ratings to boot
comments.cloudbuster: Ran well at Pontefract nine days ago; heading in right direction; respected
comments.dabbling: Showed ability in Beverley event but likely lacks potential
comments.empressolivia: 3,500gns foal; by Sergei Prokofiev; yard has modest record with 2yos
comments.enjoythenight: Likely to be more interesting in nurseries shortly
comments.ourheromatty: One of the main players on his May efforts; has regressed since
comments.pulltherug: Recorded a meagre RPR at Haydock but this shorter trip may suit
comments.resdevkisses: Failed to beat a rival in Hamilton maiden
comments.resdevtime: 10,000gns foal; half-sister to a winner (including 2yo debut) for her stable
comments.valorspirit: Third-place finishes in small-field events; frame possibilities
comments.whiskeyneat: Down the field in both outings

races.raceComment: chairmanfourtimes is marginally preferred with a score of 43.3%, holding clear edges in stronger recent form and more progressive and more reliable profile over ourheromatty. Placed in 3 of last 3 starts. Yet to win at pontefract in 3 attempts. Key attributes include superior ratings and consistent performer and improving, though step up in class and unfavorable draw need consideration.

verdict.comment: With the form of his Nottingham win franked, LOUIE THE LEGEND (nap) could well follow up. Anjo Bonita is second pick.

comments.anjobonita: Shapes as if this drop back to 1m is worth exploring; on a handy mark
comments.arkenstaar: Has bits of C&D form but is still seeking first win away from Hamilton
comments.bazball: Not solid on her form for current yard and this trip is an unknown
comments.eeetee: Well on top under Jack Nicholls at Redcar last Sunday; escapes a penalty
comments.keatshouse: Prevailed narrowly at Beverley then ran creditably at Hamilton; in-form 3yo
comments.louiethelegend: Justified favouritism at Nottingham last time, beating a subsequent scorer
comments.lovette: Thrice-raced filly who got off the mark at Ripon most recently; unexposed
comments.projectgeofin: Recorded an AW win off this mark on last go in this grade; 0-8 on turf
comments.shesgotbottle: 2-2 over C&D but has a question mark over current form
comments.superhit: Has become nicely treated, having gained both handicap wins off this mark
comments.testimonial: Inconsistent (2727) since handicapping; not sure what to expect

races.raceComment: eeetee is marginally preferred with a score of 51.6%, holding clear edges in stronger recent form and more reliable profile over louiethelegend. Won 2 of last 6 starts. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter. Key attributes include optimal distance, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile and regressive form need consideration.

verdict.comment: The 8yo VENTURA EXPRESS looks ready to go in again after his excellent effort in defeat at Beverley.

comments.bosh: Best efforts for Richard Hannon read well but hasn't got a lot going for current yard
comments.brummell: Beverley winner in April but below that level since, especially last time
comments.eleganterin: Three successive seconds before dropped in from a tricky draw at Newcastle
comments.fujimountain: Capable off this sort of mark but tailed off at York last time and can be hard to predict
comments.spiritofapplause: Doesn't have the best of records at York so no surprise that he struggled there last time
comments.theactor: Has finished last in two runs for this yard on either side of wind surgery
comments.venturaexpress: Second at Beverley last time in a 5f race he does well in and was perhaps unlucky

races.raceComment: venturaexpress is marginally preferred with a score of 52.2%, holding clear edges in more progressive over eleganterin. Placed in 2 of last 6 starts. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: The clear pick of the 3yos on form is DESERT BEAUTY, who could well build on her Leicester win. Filey Beach is second pick.

comments.bibendum: 19-race maiden; makes debut for new stable
comments.canariasun: Raced only four times; bred to do better, being related to winners for his yard
comments.desertbeauty: Off the mark at Leicester ten days ago, taking well to cheekpieces; respected
comments.fileybeach: 4yo maiden; ran encouragingly on stable/seasonal debut; drops in trip; possibilities
comments.flaviustitus: Won this race (off 4lb higher) last year; good chance if back to that form
comments.gisasub: Poor strike-rate but went close at Ripon last weekend and has a fighting chance
comments.goldenprosperity: Won classified event in June; inconsistent otherwise this year
comments.ladybouquet: All wins over 5f, including at Catterick latest start; unconvincing record at 6f
comments.makingmoves: Poor claims on her maiden/novice form, including 7:15 Windsor Saturday
comments.raincap: On a two-year losing spell but posted a solid effort at Hamilton most recently
comments.sharktwoone: Largely in good form at 6f-1m this season, notably classified success in June
comments.sportinglife: Chance depends on how well he responds to first-time headgear

races.raceComment: flaviustitus is marginally preferred with a score of 55.1%, holding clear edges in more proven at trip over ladybouquet. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

races.drawBiasExplanation: Longer distance reduces impact of draw position

verdict.comment: It's hard to see beyond DIGNAM, who was the best of these on the Flat and won with a lot left in the tank on his recent hurdling debut.

comments.battlestride: Made the frame in a low-grade AW handicap in April but best watched on stable/hurdle debut
comments.dignam: Useful Flat racer who won easily on hurdling debut at Newton Abbot a week ago
comments.genbu: This season's Flat form has been very disappointing; looks too risky on hurdle debut
comments.georginio: Fair Flat racer; shaped with promise when fourth on recent hurdle debut; each-way claims
comments.glenridding: Placed over 1m2f on the Flat in May and has realistic each-way claims on hurdling debut
comments.itslife: Has shown some aptitude for hurdling this month but her form is modest
comments.jesterqueen: Well down the Flat in basement-grade classified race 12 days ago and now 0-8 on the Flat
comments.junkyarddog: Bought for 32,000gns after finishing third on recent hurdling debut at Tipperary
comments.manyanablue: Respectable third behind Dignam last week; might collect another minor prize here
comments.misterknockout: Out of form on AW when last seen in February/March; makes stable/hurdle debut here
comments.rivermoon: Tailed off on last month's debut but subsequent wind op may enable improvement
comments.split: Won slow-ground hurdle in France in May; well held on next outing and ran out last time
comments.thedarkbaron: Disappointing maiden on the Flat in Ireland (seven starts); bought for 4,000gns last month
comments.zaraquelle: 0-6 on the Flat but showed some fair form; with good stable for hurdling career

races.raceComment: dignam is confidently preferred with a score of 55.3%, holding clear edges in better suited by conditions and stronger recent form and superior course form over manyanablue. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter. Key attributes include positive comments, though inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: The suggestion is JLOW, who has been knocking on the door for her new stable in recent weeks and sports first-time cheekpieces today.

comments.auntiemaggie: Made wll three times this spring (once over C&D); held this month but may improve again
comments.bellemontrose: 0-6 over hurdles; ran quite well when last in action but that was four months ago
comments.bluebella: Ran big race in defeat behind Quick Of The Night in new cheekpieces this month; considered
comments.getmetothemoon: Absent since game win at Plumpton in February but only 2lb higher here; a possible
comments.grannyhawkins: Didn't fire last time but was placed in first two handicaps; drops back in trip today
comments.jlow: Arrives here after three good efforts; player if aided by new cheekpieces
comments.ladybuttercup: 0-6 over hurdles; ran quite well two starts ago; raced too freely last time; now hooded
comments.milajess: In the frame all three starts since breakthtough win in April but others appeal more
comments.pacific: Came good with clearcut win at Worcester (2m4f) this month; contender if okay back at 2m
comments.prophetsqueeze: Unexposed 7yo who shaped quite well on recent handicap debut; drops back from 2m6f
comments.puregold: Tends to race too freely but comes here after two pretty good fourths at Perth this month
comments.queenswish: Not yet fully exposed but was just a respectable third on last month's stable debut
comments.quickofthenight: Returned from break in prime form at Worcester this month; respected off 5lb higher here
comments.remembermoi: Well held in Worcester race won by Quick Of The Night this month; now 0-7 over hurdles
comments.violeta: Dual Flat winner; very poor form over hurdles; still worth market check on handicap debut

comments.breakingcover: Narrow winner of C&D novice on Friday; faces much tougher task under penalty today
comments.enthused: Seven hurdle wins (two over C&D); down in grade after running well in recent Summer Hurdle
comments.gavin: Looked back in good nick when clear second at Market Rasen last weekend
comments.leloopa: Won valuable series final by 8l in March; returns on 10lb higher mark today
comments.lindenlane: Ran quite well over 2m on handicap hurdle debut but tailed off in 2m5f maiden since
comments.lunarsovereign: Ran well in two competitive handicaps this spring; dangerous to ignore off current mark
comments.realisticoptimism: Upped in grade after this month's 2m2f Stratford win but could still have more to offer
comments.strollonby: Game winner at Market Rasen this month, after a layoff; this race looks stronger, though
comments.taraiti: Four wins (one over C&D) for new stable since March; might be on a tough mark now, though
comments.timeinterval: Made all twice in May and last month's C&D second was also a good effort; respected
comments.vocito: Creditable third in refitted cheekpieces at Worcester last month; high on the list here

verdict.comment: A competitive chase as expected but YOUNG BUSTER got off lightly with just a 4lb nudge for winning so easily at Kempton in the spring.

comments.artofdiplomacy: Up to a career-high mark after winning so well last time but firmly in the reckoning
comments.ashtownlad: Lost his way for the Skeltons and troubles have continued for his new yard
comments.harryshope: Up in grade but remains on a competitive mark and the break should have done her good
comments.lordaccord: Capable on his day but very poor the last twice and looks risky at the minute
comments.manothepeople: Cheltenham winner in April; cheekpieces are back on after trying blinkers last time
comments.oliverstravels: Fourth over C&D latest and Sean Bowen stays faithful
comments.pimlicopoint: Dropped to a useful mark and definite claims if building on latest Worcester second
comments.shanaghbob: Left Nicky Henderson for £43,000; ran okay on stable debut but no more than that
comments.villagemaster: 8-10 over fences and game in winning last time; only 4lb higher but in a classier race
comments.wasdelldundalk: Goes particularly well at Perth where he's gone down narrowly the last twice
comments.youngbuster: Made it 4-9 over fences when coming clear for 24l success at Kempton in April; only up 4lb

races.raceComment: artofdiplomacy is confidently preferred with a score of 72.3%, holding clear edges in stronger recent form and superior course form and more progressive and more reliable profile over lordaccord. Won 2 of last 6 starts. Ground (Good) looks ideal with 6 wins from 24 starts in similar conditions. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter. Key attributes include strong course form and positive comments and improving, though step up in class need consideration.

comments.docmccoy: Had been in good form until a disappointing effort here on Friday; needs quick rebound
comments.earthking: 4-11 over hurdles after this month's stylish C&D win (several flights omitted); a player
comments.jaytee: Back from long absence with two disappointing runs this season; revival needed
comments.keelstrand: Improving 5yo who comes here after three consecutive wins at Newton Abbot; good chance
comments.minellarescue: Won over C&D in May and last month's C&D second was another career-best effort; respected
comments.partybusiness: Seemed to run quite well in three-runner C&D race last month but others appeal more
comments.poundingpoet: Didn't run badly over C&D last month but is not the force of old; headgear switched
comments.saintbibiana: Completed hat-trick with C&D win in first-time cheekpieces last month; obvious contender
comments.wbee: Good third at Cartmel in May, after a layoff, but two lesser efforts have followed

races.raceComment: saintbibiana is confidently preferred with a score of 67.4%, holding clear edges in better ratings and better suited by conditions and stronger recent form and superior course form and more progressive and more reliable profile over earthking. Won 3 of last 6 starts. Excellent course form of 7/21 at uttoxeter. Key attributes include strong course form and improving, though inconsistent profile need consideration.

comments.collingham: Last of four over fences on yard debut and then fifth of seven over hurdles
comments.goldenambition: Kicked off over fences with fairly close thirds over 2m5f here and 2m7f at Worcester
comments.kilmurryjj: Early days with this yard; given a lot to do when beaten about 8l over C&D latest
comments.midnightjewel: Recent Stratford winner; remains competitively treated and has plenty in his favour
comments.moodofthemoment: Three chase wins last year but current wellbeing looks a big issue; new yard
comments.presentandcounting: Pleasing efforts the last twice but has to concede years and weight to his rivals
comments.rabymere: In form over hurdles for this yard and could easily continue the good work over fences
comments.thegypsydavey: Dual chase winner at Hereford; ran okay last time as 2m was on the sharp side

races.raceComment: midnightjewel is marginally preferred with a score of 61.3%, holding clear edges in better ratings and stronger recent form over moodofthemoment. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Ground (Good) looks ideal with 8 wins from 30 starts in similar conditions. Strong pace likely with multiple front-runners. Excellent course form of 9/31 at uttoxeter. Key attributes include optimal distance and positive comments, though inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: If the first-time tongue-tie can trigger something then JACK'S JURY might be the answer after running well in all his handicaps.

comments.beaugold: Enters handicaps with an awful lot to prove and principally of interest due to connections
comments.chillhi: Mixed record for current yard but second on the Flat last week and ability is respected
comments.dalileo: Likely contender in current form after finishing first and third in 3m handicaps at Perth
comments.damesarra: Flat and novice hurdle winner; 25-1 when tailed off on handicap debut last month
comments.esteban: 66-1 for British debut in a Worcester handicap and was well held when falling
comments.fennasloss: 8yo on a slippery slope, over hurdles and fences; very opposable
comments.goldlink: His best days have no doubt passed him by but respected at this level
comments.inoue: 11-race maiden with an unconvincing profile and he's 7lb out of the weights on yard debut
comments.jacksjury: Has performed well in all three handicaps and first-time tongue-tie could give him a lift
comments.jeepydoffmeel: Lost way for previous yard and has much to prove on debut for this one after an absence
comments.leadinglion: Running well when unseating three out in his last jumps run; since tailed off on the Flat
comments.presentfair: Front two were clear when winning at Bangor 23 days ago and only raised 4lb for that
comments.wildnephin: Hasn't taken to fences the last twice and better expected here off what's a fair mark.

races.raceComment: presentfair is marginally preferred with a score of 59.6%, holding clear edges in stronger recent form over goldlink. Won 2 of last 6 starts. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter. Key attributes include excellent form and optimal distance and positive comments, though inconsistent profile and regressive form need consideration.
